title: Gosip Pohon
tagline: tap the secrets in the tree
description: Secrets peek out of the branches of {name}'s tree. Tap each one before it hides, but leave the crows and bats alone. Three lives, and it gets faster.

how.en: Tap the glowing secrets before they hide (or press 1 to 9). Don't touch the crow or the bat!
how.id: Tap rahasia yang menyala sebelum bersembunyi (atau tekan 1 sampai 9). Jangan sentuh gagak atau kelelawar!

en: Hihi, the secrets hid from you! Again, again, I want to hear them!
Ooh, so few! Who was whispering up there?!
id: Hihi, rahasianya sembunyi dari kamu! Lagi, lagi, aku mau dengar!
Ooh, sedikit banget! Siapa tadi yang bisik-bisik di atas sana?!

en: Ooh, good ears! What did the secrets say? Tell me, tell me!
Hihi, quick fingers! One more round, there are still more secrets up there!
id: Ooh, telingamu tajam! Rahasianya bilang apa? Ceritain, ceritain!
Hihi, jarimu cepat! Satu ronde lagi, masih banyak rahasia di atas sana!

en: WOW, you caught almost all the gossip!! Spill everything you heard!!
Hihihi, you're SO nosy, I love it! What did the secrets say?!
id: WAH, hampir semua gosip kamu tangkap!! Bocorin semua yang kamu dengar!!
Hihihi, kamu kepo banget, aku suka! Rahasianya bilang apa?!

en: A NEW RECORD!! I'm telling the whole tree! Hihihi!
Best gossip catcher ever!! Come closer, I have a secret just for you!
id: REKOR BARU!! Aku kasih tahu satu pohon! Hihihi!
Penangkap gosip terbaik!! Sini dekat, aku punya rahasia khusus buat kamu!

id.description: Rahasia mengintip dari dahan-dahan pohon {name}. Tap tiap rahasia sebelum bersembunyi, tapi jangan sentuh gagak dan kelelawar. Tiga nyawa, dan makin lama makin cepat.
